about: Calls that still go around a provider, checked by tools/testing/provider_check.py, which needs this to match exactly. Each says why. It should shrink as they move behind a provider.

src/remaster/remaster_movies.c:lom_nativ.why: Checks the Remaster's movie is there, then FFmpeg opens it by its path itself, so a fake provider can't serve it yet.

src/remaster/remaster_text_scenes.c:dump.why: Writes the scene text it built to a folder for debugging (LOM_REMASTER_TEXT_DUMP), not one of the Remaster's files.

src/cd/cdrom_native.c:queue_callback_rea.why: Streams a file a sector at a time to the game's callback, keeping it open; the disc provider only reads whole files so far.

src/cd/cdrom_native.c:lom_native_mod_dis.why: Reads a disc file for a mod; still to move behind the disc provider.

src/cd/cdrom_native.c:list_mod_folder.why: Lists a disc folder for a mod; the disc provider can't list folders yet.

src/cd/cdrom_native.c:lom_native_mod_dis.why: Checks a disc folder is there for a mod; the disc provider can't list folders yet.
